candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue for the twelve months of 2025 reached 53.2 million euros, representing a substantial increase compared to 18.2 million euros in 2024.
Gross profit for 2025 rose to 18.8 million euros with a gross profit margin of 35 percent, compared to 5.4 million euros and a 30 percent margin in 2024.
Operating profit improved sharply to 14.7 million euros, or 28 percent of revenue, compared to just 123 thousand euros in 2024.
The Group recorded a net profit of 12.0 million euros for 2025, recovering from a net loss of 3.9 million euros in the previous year.
Basic earnings per share turned positive at 0.22 euros for the twelve months of 2025, compared to negative 0.06 euros in 2024.
Cash generated from operating activities improved to 10.8 million euros in 2025, contrasting with cash used of 10.4 million euros during 2024.
Total assets increased to 124.5 million euros as of 31 December 2025, up from 118.8 million euros a year earlier, while total liabilities decreased to 61.2 million euros from 67.5 million euros.
Total equity rose to 63.3 million euros from 51.2 million euros, and net asset value per share increased to 1.12 euros from 0.89 euros.
The debt to equity ratio improved to 0.97 at the end of 2025 from 1.32 at the end of 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Revenue growth was primarily driven by the handover of completed residential units in the Kalaranna District and Uus-Kindrali developments in Tallinn, as well as the City Villas project in Vilnius, contrasting lower 2024 revenue due to delayed starts in Kalaranna and limited sales elsewhere.
